scope: Diagnosis only; no training or physics changes. Default Tc=4, eps_star=.0225 unless checkpoint config specifies otherwise.

direct_float64.scheme: RK4 float64, exact 64^3 symmetry reduction of 128^3 graph

direct_half_dt_float64.scheme: RK4 float64, exact 64^3 symmetry reduction of 128^3 graph

limitations: Radial Neumann sphere r=.5 is an independent interior control, not the exact cube boundary-value problem.
Direct 64^3 octant uses even coordinate symmetry of the 128^3 cube grid; stored line is y=z=h/2 from centre. Weights are recomputed in float64 from the declared kernel.
Graph-convolution experiments, missing-config runs and snapshots without a confirmed historical architecture are excluded.
Examined default checkpoints retain ice at t<=1; exact user-reported full-disappearance run remains unidentified.
